tactics: cases i <;> simp_all [Nat.testBit_zero, Nat.pow_succ, Nat.add_mod, Nat.mul_mod]

cases i with
  | zero => simp_all
  | succ k =>
    have h2 : (2 ^ (k+1) * a + b) % 2 = b % 2 := by
      rw [Nat.pow_succ, Nat.mul_comm (2^k) 2, Nat.mul_assoc, Nat.mul_add_mod]
    simp [Nat.testBit_zero, h2]
